speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma, Mild Persistent (with normal FeNO and Methacholine Challenge, the findings are consistent with mild persistent asthma or potentially cough-variant asthma given the bronchial thickening and reduced flow ratio, though the normal challenge test is atypical for classic asthma and may suggest early-stage disease or measurement variability).
